protocol.blinding: Every lane received raw artifacts without the oracle or other lane outputs.

notes: Raw lane outputs, exact prompt hashes, and the root-cause normalization ledger were not retained; numeric duplicate and byte values are historical reports, not reproducible test facts.
Root causes were normalized by case and evidenced defect, not by lane-provided key spelling.
The first target pass without explicit ownership left median duplicates unchanged at two; that failed iteration is why the final dossier contract requires owned risks and adjacent-lane exclusions.
The target sample retained all five seeded critical/important roots used by the primary quality comparator and also isolated accessibility, invalid-input, and purchase-boundary observations.
